history.description: Busetto2024 PMID39188014 and its publisher supplement support 14 scoped graphs with 24 OBSERVED edges: 19 DIRECT physical/biochemical effects, 3 INDIRECT cellular effects and 2 UNRESOLVED coexpression recovery effects. Four evidence ledgers preserve exact reference/Pfam boundaries, wider experimental CTDs, extra-domain substitutions, affinity and mutant-numbering discrepancies, tag/solubility controls, conditional negatives and unreviewed member contexts. Primary figures1-7 and selected supplement figures/tables were inspected. Imported snapshot identity and counters remain unchanged; status IN_PROGRESS with two OPEN discussions. Baseline 8296 records had zero generated drift. Native regeneration and retained review follow; no publication or independent endorsement.

evidence.explanation: Separate binding,cleavage,coexpression and cellular readouts support scoped effects; they do not prove the matched Pfam segment is sufficient.

Figure7A truncated Kd33.4 conflicts with Results18.7/S8C18.69. Figure5/S1 D435A conflicts with Results D453A. discussions.prompt: Resolve construct and source discrepancies without treating broad-CTD assays as isolated Pfam mechanisms.
discussions.rationale: The experimental CTD is wider than the current Pfam match; extra-domain substitutions, affinity-label conflicts and tag differences limit attribution.

evidence.explanation: Native small-RNA substrates and the ancestral archaeal/bacterial role remain unresolved despite animal binding and degradation assays.
Neuronal MUT-7/22G contexts require a separate primary-assay and construct review.
